# calculate the true values of wOR 
pc <- c(0.69, 0.18, 0.005, 0.09, 0.02, 0.01, 0.005)

alphas <- logit(cumsum(pc_control))
pt1 <- pc_control
# x2 beta 
beta2 <- 0.95

beta3 <- -1
# simulation scenarios 
# scenario 1: null 
beta1_1 <- 0 
pc1 <- c(expit(alphas[1] - 0.5 * beta1_1),

  pt <- as.numeric(scenarios1[2*i, 1:7])

  PPO_trt_leq <- cumsum(pt)
  PPO_ctl_geq <- revcumsum(pc)
  PPO_trt_geq <- revcumsum(pt)
  p_y_ctl <- pc
  p_y_trt <- pt

  j <- 1:(c-1)
  k <- 2:c

                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI9_100_83_67_50_33_17_0blrm)),
                   OR6_stratified = sum((log_OR_95CI11_100_83_67_50_33_17_0 < log(true_OR6) & 
                          log_OR_95CI12_100_83_67_50_33_17_0 > log(true_OR6)), na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI11_100_83_67_50_33_17_0)),
                   OR6_blrm = sum((log_OR_95CI11_100_83_67_50_33_17_0blrm < log(true_OR6) & 
                          log_OR_95CI12_100_83_67_50_33_17_0blrm > log(true_OR6)), na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI11_100_83_67_50_33_17_0blrm))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(OR1_stratified, OR1_blrm, OR2_stratified, OR2_blrm, OR3_stratified, OR3_blrm,
                        OR4_stratified, OR4_blrm, OR5_stratified, OR5_blrm, OR6_stratified, OR6_blrm),
               names_to = "measures", values_to = "coverage") %>%
  separate(measures, into = c("Summary", "Model"), sep = "_") %>%
  merge(strat_vs_blrm_table, by = c("Scenario", "Summary", "Model"))

pc <- c(0.70, 0.18, 0.09, 0.02, 0.01)
pc2 <- c(0.70, 0.18, 0.09, 0.02, 0.01)

pt1 <- pc2
# x2 beta 
beta2 <- 0.75
# x3 beta 
beta3 <- -0.1
# simulation scenarios

beta1_1 <- 0 
pc1 <- c(expit(alphas[1] - 0.5 * beta1_1), 
         expit(alphas[2] - 0.5 * beta1_1) - expit(alphas[1] - 0.5 * beta1_1),
         expit(alphas[3] - 0.5 * beta1_1) - expit(alphas[2] - 0.5 * beta1_1),
         expit(alphas[4] - 0.5 * beta1_1) - expit(alphas[3] - 0.5 * beta1_1),
         1 - expit(alphas[4] - 0.5 * beta1_1))
pt1 <- pc1 
# scenario 2: PO

         expit(alphas[2] - 0.5 * beta1_2) - expit(alphas[1] - 0.5 * beta1_2),
         expit(alphas[3] - 0.5 * beta1_2) - expit(alphas[2] - 0.5 * beta1_2),

beta13_6 <- log(1.21)

pc6 <- c(expit(alphas[1] - 0.5 * beta11_6), 
         expit(alphas[2] - 0.5 * beta12_6) - expit(alphas[1] - 0.5 * beta11_6),
         expit(alphas[3] - 0.5 * beta13_6) - expit(alphas[2] - 0.5 * beta12_6),
         expit(alphas[4] - 0.5 * beta14_6) - expit(alphas[3] - 0.5 * beta13_6),
         1 - expit(alphas[4] - 0.5 * beta14_6))
pt6 <- c(expit(alphas[1] + 0.5 * beta11_6), 
         expit(alphas[2] + 0.5 * beta12_6) - expit(alphas[1] + 0.5 * beta11_6),
         expit(alphas[3] + 0.5 * beta13_6) - expit(alphas[2] + 0.5 * beta12_6),
         expit(alphas[4] + 0.5 * beta14_6) - expit(alphas[3] + 0.5 * beta13_6),
         1 - expit(alphas[4] + 0.5 * beta14_6))
# scenario 7: NP 4
beta11_7 <- log(1.52)
beta12_7 <- log(3) # 3.76
beta13_7 <- log(3.25)
beta14_7 <- log(4.03)
pc7 <- c(expit(alphas[1] - 0.5 * beta11_7), 
         expit(alphas[2] - 0.5 * beta12_7) - expit(alphas[1] - 0.5 * beta11_7),
         expit(alphas[3] - 0.5 * beta13_7) - expit(alphas[2] - 0.5 * beta12_7),
         expit(alphas[4] - 0.5 * beta14_7) - expit(alphas[3] - 0.5 * beta13_7),

pt7 <- c(expit(alphas[1] + 0.5 * beta11_7),

# check standardized effect size for scenarios
wOR_100_75_50_25_0 <- NA
mean_utility_100_75_50_25_0 <- NA
wOR_100_90_60_10_0 <- NA
mean_utility_100_90_60_10_0 <- NA
wOR_100_90_80_60_0 <- NA
mean_utility_100_90_80_60_0 <- NA
NB <- NA
true_ORs_5level <- matrix(nrow = 9, ncol = 5)
true_RRs <- matrix(nrow = 9, ncol = 5)
true_power_100_75_50_25_0 <- NA
true_power_100_90_60_10_0 <- NA
true_power_100_90_80_60_0 <- NA
true_power2_100_75_50_25_0 <- NA
true_power2_100_90_60_10_0 <- NA
true_power2_100_90_80_60_0 <- NA

for (i in 1:(nrow(scenarios1)/2)) {
  pc <- as.numeric(scenarios1[2*i - 1, 1:5])
  pt <- as.numeric(scenarios1[2*i, 1:5])
  PPO_ctl_leq <- cumsum(pc)
  PPO_trt_leq <- cumsum(pt)
  PPO_ctl_geq <- revcumsum(pc)
  PPO_trt_geq <- revcumsum(pt)
  p_y_ctl <- pc
  p_y_trt <- pt

  c <- 5
  j <- 1:(c-1)
  k <- 2:c


OR_le <- (PPO_trt_leq / (1- PPO_trt_leq)) / (PPO_ctl_leq / (1- PPO_ctl_leq))
OR_ge <- (PPO_ctl_geq / (1- PPO_ctl_geq)) / (PPO_trt_geq / (1- PPO_trt_geq))

true_ORs_5level[i,] <- OR_le
# # calculate RR 
  log_RR_le <- log(PPO_trt_leq/PPO_ctl_leq)
  
true_RRs[i,] <- log_RR_le
#   log_RR_ge <- log(PPO_ctl_geq/PPO_trt_geq)
utility <- c(100, 75, 50, 25, 0)
#calculate weighted OR 
  # fully bayesian with both cumulative and split weights
  numerator <- sum((p_y_ctl[j] + p_y_ctl[k]) * 
                     (abs(utility[j] - utility[k])) * 
                     (PPO_ctl_leq[j] * (1-PPO_ctl_leq[j])) * log(OR_le[j]))
  denominator <- sum((p_y_ctl[j] + p_y_ctl[k]) * 
                       (abs(utility[j] - utility[k])) * (PPO_ctl_leq[j] * (1-PPO_ctl_leq[j])))
wOR_100_75_50_25_0[i] <- exp(numerator/denominator)

# true power 
true_power_100_75_50_25_0[i] <- ordinal_power_utility_null(pc = pc, A = 1, 
                                                      pt = pt, alpha = 0.05, 
                                                      n = 1000, utilities = utility)

true_power2_100_75_50_25_0[i] <- ordinal_power_utility_new(pc = pc, A = 1, 
                                                      pt = pt, alpha = 0.05, 
                                                      n = 1000, utilities = utility)

l <- 1:5
mean_utility_100_75_50_25_0[i] <- sum(utility[l] * p_y_trt[l]) - sum(utility[l] * p_y_ctl[l])

utility <- c(100, 90, 60, 10, 0)
#calculate weighted OR 
  # fully bayesian with both cumulative and split weights
  numerator <- sum((p_y_ctl[j] + p_y_ctl[k]) * 
                     (abs(utility[j] - utility[k])) * 
                     (PPO_ctl_leq[j] * (1-PPO_ctl_leq[j])) * log(OR_le[j]))
  denominator <- sum((p_y_ctl[j] + p_y_ctl[k]) * 
                       (abs(utility[j] - utility[k])) * (PPO_ctl_leq[j] * (1-PPO_ctl_leq[j])))
wOR_100_90_60_10_0[i] <- exp(numerator/denominator)

mean_utility_100_90_60_10_0[i] <- sum(utility[l] * p_y_trt[l]) - sum(utility[l] * p_y_ctl[l])

# true power 
true_power_100_90_60_10_0[i] <- ordinal_power_utility_null(pc = pc, A = 1, 
                                                      pt = pt, alpha = 0.05, 
                                                      n = 1000, utilities = utility)

true_power2_100_90_60_10_0[i] <- ordinal_power_utility_new(pc = pc, A = 1, 
                                                      pt = pt, alpha = 0.05, 
                                                      n = 1000, utilities = utility)

utility <- c(100, 90, 80, 60, 0)
#calculate weighted OR 
  # fully bayesian with both cumulative and split weights
  numerator <- sum((p_y_ctl[j] + p_y_ctl[k]) * 
                     (abs(utility[j] - utility[k])) * 
                     (PPO_ctl_leq[j] * (1-PPO_ctl_leq[j])) * log(OR_le[j]))
  denominator <- sum((p_y_ctl[j] + p_y_ctl[k]) * 
                       (abs(utility[j] - utility[k])) * (PPO_ctl_leq[j] * (1-PPO_ctl_leq[j])))
wOR_100_90_80_60_0[i] <- exp(numerator/denominator)

mean_utility_100_90_80_60_0[i] <- sum(utility[l] * p_y_trt[l]) - sum(utility[l] * p_y_ctl[l])

# true power 
true_power_100_90_80_60_0[i] <- ordinal_power_utility_null(pc = pc, A = 1, 
                                                      pt = pt, alpha = 0.05, 
                                                      n = 1000, utilities = utility)

true_power2_100_90_80_60_0[i] <- ordinal_power_utility_new(pc = pc, A = 1, 
                                                      pt = pt, alpha = 0.05, 
                                                      n = 1000, utilities = utility)

# true net benefit 
NB[i] <- sum(p_y_trt[j] * PPO_ctl_geq[j+1]) - (sum(p_y_ctl[j] * PPO_trt_geq[j+1]))

}

  mutate_if(is.character, as.numeric) %>% 
  merge(true_ORs_5level, by = "Scenario") %>% 
  merge(true_vals, by = "Scenario") %>% 
  mutate(bias_OR1 = log_OR1_100_75_50_25_0 - log(true_OR1),
         bias_OR1blrm = log_OR1_100_75_50_25_0blrm - log(true_OR1),
         bias_OR2 = log_OR2_100_75_50_25_0 - log(true_OR2),
         bias_OR2blrm = log_OR2_100_75_50_25_0blrm - log(true_OR2),
         bias_OR3 = log_OR3_100_75_50_25_0 - log(true_OR3),
         bias_OR3blrm = log_OR3_100_75_50_25_0blrm - log(true_OR3),
         bias_OR4 = log_OR4_100_75_50_25_0 - log(true_OR4),
         bias_OR4blrm = log_OR4_100_75_50_25_0blrm - log(true_OR4),
         bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0 = log_weighted_OR_both_100_75_50_25_0 - log(true_wOR_100_75_50_25_0),
         bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0blrm = log_weighted_OR_both_100_75_50_25_0blrm - log(true_wOR_100_75_50_25_0), 
         CIwidth_OR1 = log_OR_95CI2_100_75_50_25_0 - log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0,
         CIwidth_OR1blrm = log_OR_95CI2_100_75_50_25_0blrm - log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0blrm,
         CIwidth_OR2 = log_OR_95CI4_100_75_50_25_0 - log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0,
         CIwidth_OR2blrm = log_OR_95CI4_100_75_50_25_0blrm - log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0blrm,
         CIwidth_OR3 = log_OR_95CI6_100_75_50_25_0 - log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0,
         CIwidth_OR3blrm = log_OR_95CI6_100_75_50_25_0blrm - log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0blrm,
         CIwidth_OR4 = log_OR_95CI8_100_75_50_25_0 - log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0,
         CIwidth_OR4blrm = log_OR_95CI8_100_75_50_25_0blrm - log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0blrm,
         CI_width_wOR = `log_wOR_both_95CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0` -
           `log_wOR_both_95CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0`,
         CI_width_wOR_blrm = `log_wOR_both_95CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0blrm` -
           `log_wOR_both_95CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0blrm`) %>%
  group_by(Scenario) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
            OR1_stratified_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR1^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR1))),
            OR1_blrm_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR1blrm^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR1blrm))),
            OR2_stratified_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR2^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR2))),
            OR2_blrm_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR2blrm^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR2blrm))),
            OR3_stratified_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR3^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR3))),
            OR3_blrm_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR3blrm^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR3blrm))),
            OR4_stratified_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR4^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR4))),
            OR4_blrm_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR4blrm^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR4blrm))),
            wOR_stratified_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0))),
            wOR_blrm_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0blrm^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0blrm))),
            OR1_stratified_Power = sum((log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0 > 0 & 
                          log_OR_95CI2_100_75_50_25_0 > 0) |
                            (log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0 < 0 &
                          log_OR_95CI2_100_75_50_25_0 < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0)),
            OR2_stratified_Power = sum((log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0 > 0 & 
                          log_OR_95CI4_100_75_50_25_0 > 0) |
                            (log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0 < 0 &
                          log_OR_95CI4_100_75_50_25_0 < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0)),
            OR3_stratified_Power = sum((log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0 > 0 & 
                          log_OR_95CI6_100_75_50_25_0 > 0) |
                            (log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0 < 0 &
                          log_OR_95CI6_100_75_50_25_0 < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0)),
            OR4_stratified_Power = sum((log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0 > 0 & 
                          log_OR_95CI8_100_75_50_25_0 > 0) |
                            (log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0 < 0 &
                          log_OR_95CI8_100_75_50_25_0 < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0)),
            wOR_stratified_Power = sum((`log_wOR_both_95CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0` > 0 & 
                          `log_wOR_both_95CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0` > 0) |
                            (`log_wOR_both_95CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0` < 0 &
                          `log_wOR_both_95CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0` < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(`log_wOR_both_95CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0`)),
            OR1_blrm_Power = sum((log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0blrm > 0 & 
                          log_OR_95CI2_100_75_50_25_0blrm > 0) |
                            (log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0blrm < 0 &
                          log_OR_95CI2_100_75_50_25_0blrm < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0blrm)),
            OR2_blrm_Power = sum((log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0blrm > 0 & 
                          log_OR_95CI4_100_75_50_25_0blrm > 0) |
                            (log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0blrm < 0 &
                          log_OR_95CI4_100_75_50_25_0blrm < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0blrm)),
            OR3_blrm_Power = sum((log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0blrm > 0 & 
                          log_OR_95CI6_100_75_50_25_0blrm > 0) |
                            (log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0blrm < 0 &
                          log_OR_95CI6_100_75_50_25_0blrm < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0blrm)),
            OR4_blrm_Power = sum((log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0blrm > 0 & 
                          log_OR_95CI8_100_75_50_25_0blrm > 0) |
                            (log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0blrm < 0 &
                          log_OR_95CI8_100_75_50_25_0blrm < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0blrm)),
            wOR_blrm_Power = sum((`log_wOR_both_95CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0blrm` > 0 & 
                          `log_wOR_both_95CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0blrm` > 0) |
                            (`log_wOR_both_95CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0blrm` < 0 &
                          `log_wOR_both_95CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0blrm` < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(`log_wOR_both_95CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0blrm`)),
            OR1_stratified_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR1),
            OR1_blrm_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR1blrm),
            OR2_stratified_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR2),
            OR2_blrm_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR2blrm),
            OR3_stratified_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR3),
            OR3_blrm_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR3blrm),
            OR4_stratified_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR4),
            OR4_blrm_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR4blrm),
            wOR_stratified_CIwidth = mean(CI_width_wOR),
            wOR_blrm_CIwidth = mean(CI_width_wOR_blrm)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !Scenario,
               names_to = "Measure",
               values_to = "Value") %>%
  separate(Measure, c("Summary", "Model", "Measure")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Measure", values_from = "Value") %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3)))

coeff_null <- 1/4
ciwidth_coverage_setup <- sim_results_5level %>%
  mutate(Scenario = as.factor(case_when(array %in% 1:40 ~ "Null",
                              array %in% 41:80 ~ "Low PO", 
                              array %in% 81:120 ~ "High PO",
                              array %in% 121:160 ~ "NP 1", 
                              array %in% 161:200 ~ "NP 2",
                              array %in% 201:240 ~ "NP 3", 
                              array %in% 241:280 ~ "NP 4",
                              array %in% 281:320 ~ "NP 5", 
                              array %in% 321:360 ~ "NP 6"))) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.character, as.numeric) %>% 
  merge(true_ORs_5level, by = "Scenario") %>%
  group_by(Scenario) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(OR1_stratified = sum((log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0 < log(true_OR1) & 
                          log_OR_95CI2_100_75_50_25_0 > log(true_OR1)), na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0)),
                   OR1_blrm = sum((log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0blrm < log(true_OR1) & 
                          log_OR_95CI2_100_75_50_25_0blrm > log(true_OR1)), na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0blrm)),
                   OR2_stratified = sum((log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0 < log(true_OR2) & 
                          log_OR_95CI4_100_75_50_25_0 > log(true_OR2)), na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0)),
                   OR2_blrm = sum((log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0blrm < log(true_OR2) & 
                          log_OR_95CI4_100_75_50_25_0blrm > log(true_OR2)), na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0blrm)),
                   OR3_stratified = sum((log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0 < log(true_OR3) & 
                          log_OR_95CI6_100_75_50_25_0 > log(true_OR3)), na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0)),
                   OR3_blrm = sum((log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0blrm < log(true_OR3) & 
                          log_OR_95CI6_100_75_50_25_0blrm > log(true_OR3)), na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0blrm)),
                   OR4_stratified = sum((log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0 < log(true_OR4) & 
                          log_OR_95CI8_100_75_50_25_0 > log(true_OR4)), na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0)),
                   OR4_blrm = sum((log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0blrm < log(true_OR4) & 
                          log_OR_95CI8_100_75_50_25_0blrm > log(true_OR4)), na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0blrm))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(OR1_stratified, OR1_blrm, OR2_stratified, OR2_blrm, OR3_stratified, OR3_blrm,
                        OR4_stratified, OR4_blrm),
               names_to = "measures", values_to = "coverage") %>%
  separate(measures, into = c("Summary", "Model"), sep = "_") %>%
  merge(strat_vs_blrm_table, by = c("Scenario", "Summary", "Model"))

# plot of CI width ratio stratified to PPO
ci_width_ratio5 <- sim_results_5level %>%
  mutate(Scenario = as.factor(case_when(array %in% 1:40 ~ "Null",
                              array %in% 41:80 ~ "Low PO", 
                              array %in% 81:120 ~ "High PO",
                              array %in% 121:160 ~ "NP 1", 
                              array %in% 161:200 ~ "NP 2",
                              array %in% 201:240 ~ "NP 3", 
                              array %in% 241:280 ~ "NP 4",
                              array %in% 281:320 ~ "NP 5", 
                              array %in% 321:360 ~ "NP 6"))) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.character, as.numeric) %>% 
  merge(true_ORs_5level, by = "Scenario") %>%
  mutate(CIwidth_OR1 = log_OR_95CI2_100_75_50_25_0 - log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0,
         CIwidth_OR1blrm = log_OR_95CI2_100_75_50_25_0blrm - log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0blrm,
         CIwidth_OR2 = log_OR_95CI4_100_75_50_25_0 - log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0,
         CIwidth_OR2blrm = log_OR_95CI4_100_75_50_25_0blrm - log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0blrm,
         CIwidth_OR3 = log_OR_95CI6_100_75_50_25_0 - log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0,
         CIwidth_OR3blrm = log_OR_95CI6_100_75_50_25_0blrm - log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0blrm,
         CIwidth_OR4 = log_OR_95CI8_100_75_50_25_0 - log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0,
         CIwidth_OR4blrm = log_OR_95CI8_100_75_50_25_0blrm - log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0blrm,
         CI_width_wOR = `log_wOR_both_95CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0` -
           `log_wOR_both_95CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0`,
         CI_width_wOR_blrm = `log_wOR_both_95CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0blrm` -
           `log_wOR_both_95CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0blrm`,
         CIwidthratio_OR1 = CIwidth_OR1/CIwidth_OR1blrm,
         CIwidthratio_OR2 = CIwidth_OR2/CIwidth_OR2blrm,
         CIwidthratio_OR3 = CIwidth_OR3/CIwidth_OR3blrm,
         CIwidthratio_OR4 = CIwidth_OR4/CIwidth_OR4blrm,
         CIwidthratio_wOR = CI_width_wOR/CI_width_wOR_blrm) %>%
  dplyr::select(CIwidthratio_OR1, CIwidthratio_OR2, CIwidthratio_OR3, CIwidthratio_OR4,
                CIwidthratio_wOR, Scenario) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !Scenario,
               values_to = "CI_width",
               names_to = "Measure") %>%
  separate(Measure, c("Summary", "Measure"))

plot_setup_point_est5 <-sim_results_5level %>%
  mutate(Scenario = as.factor(case_when(array %in% 1:40 ~ "Null",
                              array %in% 41:80 ~ "Low PO", 
                              array %in% 81:120 ~ "High PO",
                              array %in% 121:160 ~ "NP 1", 
                              array %in% 161:200 ~ "NP 2",
                              array %in% 201:240 ~ "NP 3", 
                              array %in% 241:280 ~ "NP 4",
                              array %in% 281:320 ~ "NP 5", 
                              array %in% 321:360 ~ "NP 6"))) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.character, as.numeric) %>% 
  # merge(true_ORs_5level, by = "Scenario") %>%
  dplyr::select(log_OR1_100_75_50_25_0, log_OR2_100_75_50_25_0,
                log_OR3_100_75_50_25_0, log_OR4_100_75_50_25_0, 
                log_OR1_100_75_50_25_0blrm, log_OR2_100_75_50_25_0blrm,
                log_OR3_100_75_50_25_0blrm, log_OR4_100_75_50_25_0blrm, Scenario) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(log_OR1_100_75_50_25_0, log_OR2_100_75_50_25_0,
                log_OR3_100_75_50_25_0, log_OR4_100_75_50_25_0, 
                log_OR1_100_75_50_25_0blrm, log_OR2_100_75_50_25_0blrm,
                log_OR3_100_75_50_25_0blrm, log_OR4_100_75_50_25_0blrm), 
               names_to = "measures",
               values_to = "log_OR") %>%
  mutate(measure = str_extract(measures, "^[^_]+_[^_]+"),
         model = str_extract(measures, "[a-zA-Z]+$")) %>%
  mutate(model = case_when(is.na(model) ~ "stratified",
                           TRUE ~ model)) %>%
  merge(true_OR_new, by = c("Scenario", "measure"))
